Summary

A product manager who owns strategy, discovery, and delivery, and whose edge is discovery, not just delivery. Building is table stakes; the seasoned call is not what we could build but what we should, with the evidence to say why. I take an ambiguous problem, prototype a working surface in code, put it in front of real users, validate the premise and read what actually gets used, kill what doesn't, and hand engineering a hardened premise instead of a hunch. I carry all three PM hats myself - project management, product, and design/prototyping. Currently building ARCS, a GenAI app I built and run largely solo on Claude (a RAG pipeline, a live MCP server, agentic orchestration, an evaluation layer) on Next.js / TypeScript - hands-on with OpenAI and Claude. Over 15 years turning ambiguous problems into shipped, adopted systems in regulated finance ($7B, SEC/FINRA) and a mission-driven non-profit. Public commit trail at status.arcs.care; this resume was built by a tool I shipped and run, resume-tailor.arcs.care.
